description: Design a mobile app and implement its browser prototype, verify real interactions and prepare or verify a client demo link; never a native build or implicit deployment.

stages.purpose: Establish the app baseline, target platforms, client-review tasks and preview hosting constraints.

gates.require: screen/state inventory, target platforms, source reuse, demo data, hosting/base path and current publication authority are explicit

stages.purpose: Specify mobile navigation, components, states and browser-to-native differences using the existing app design system.

gates.require: current design contract, reusable components, screen/state transitions and simulated native behaviors are recorded

stages.purpose: Implement a browser presentation of the mobile design in the target project using its existing frontend and state owners; prepare static hosting assets.

gates.require: interactive prototype source, deterministic screen/state links, reset behavior and static hosting output exist; backend/native integrations are labelled

stages.purpose: Verify the browser prototype at phone/desktop sizes and hand off a prepared or independently verified hosted link; publication remains the authorized external collaborator's responsibility.

gates.require: current browser captures and interaction evidence cover primary tasks, recovery, narrow phones, desktop frame and actual hosting base paths

handoff identifies exact source/revision, current browser QA and explicit PREPARED or DEPLOYED_VERIFIED status; claim a delivered client URL only after authorized publication, provider SHA/status and live route/interaction checks

policies.reason: Recheck platform, client tasks or preview-host assumptions.
Repair the browser source/state/asset path that failed and collect fresh browser evidence.
